rules.statement: State land which is viharagam land or land held in trust under the Buddhist Temporalities Ordinance, possessed by a public company on a notarial lease does not vest in the Land Reform Commission.
rules.supporting_quote: "Agricultural land' means land used or capable of being used for agriculture within the meaning given in this Law and shall include private lands, .lands alienated under the Land Development Ordinance or the Crown Lands Ordinance or any other enactment and includes also things attached to the earth or permanently fastened to anything attached to the earth but shall exclude (a) any cultivated agricultural land owned or possessed by a public company on May 29, 1971, so long and so long only as such land continues to be so owned or possessed by such company;"
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: "Agricultural land' means land used or capable of being used for agriculture within the meaning given in this Law and shall include private lands, .lands alienated under the Land Development Ordinance or the Crown Lands Ordinance or any other enactment and includes also things attached to the earth or permanently fastened to anything attached to the earth but shall exclude (a) any cultivated agricultural land owned or possessed by a public company on May 29, 1971, so long and so long only as such land continues to be so owned or possessed by such company;"
